title: refactor: move the private docblocks of the hand-series stubs into their hand modules — about 1,900 lines off engine.ts (86 stubs) and about 4,000 off protocol.ts (157 stubs)
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: the maintainer asked for this on PR #30012 at 2026-11-04T10:03Z (「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」). The facades are merged: engine.ts as 237f5137 (#30012) and protocol.ts as 48914fdc (#29998). Estimates come from the #29986 / #29985 dev reports. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane (devx or server).

Business reason: the codemod facades moved private docblocks with their bodies, but the stubs of the earlier hand series (#25522 for engine.ts, #25467 for protocol.ts) keep their docblocks on the class: 86 stubs in `engine.ts` (up to about 1,900 lines) and 157 in `protocol.ts` (4,017 measured lines). Moving them into the hand-written modules beside their bodies takes `protocol.ts` to about 9.8k lines.
Reader who acts: `packages/objectql` / `packages/metadata-protocol` owners.

## What to do
- Move each private stub's docblock to the function it delegates to, and keep public docblocks on the facade, so the `.d.ts` stays EQUAL. Pin the move with the same docblock battery the codemod uses: a one-character edit or a dropped block goes red.
- One PR per file, each in its own short freeze window.
Dedupe: `hand-series docblock`, `25522`, `25467`. **New.**
